ns2:section.sectionText: Analyzes the markets served by various advertising media and factors to consider in the selection and evaluation of media. Markets include investors, employees, and consumer segments. This course will also cover managing media in a global context. This course is designed to provide students with an advanced understanding of media analysis, planning, buying and optimization. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisites are not being enforced for this course. Restricted to MS: SBC students. Non-Degree seeking students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of the department. To request enrollment, please contact ms-sbc@illinois.edu.
